latest_release.body:
**This is the last version of Clipy to support macOS 13 Ventura.**

If you are updating from a version earlier than v1.3.0, please export important data, such as snippets, before updating. As noted in the [v1.3.0 release notes](https://github.com/Clipy/Clipy/releases/tag/1.3.0), Clipy introduced an internal database migration from Realm to SQLite. The migration runs automatically where possible, but may fail in some cases.

### Enhancements

* Add a setting for first-item highlighting in pop-up menus by @signothecat in #768
* Remove the HTML prefix from history menu titles by @Econa77 in #758 and #773

### Bugfixes

* Fix excluded application selection on macOS 13 by @Econa77 in #762
* Fix disappearing text in long menu titles by @Econa77 in #763

### Maintenance

* Manage code signing with fastlane match by @Econa77 in #749
* Update development environment to Xcode 27 by @Econa77 in #761
* Update image source in README.md by @Econa77 in #767
* Other dependency and CI updates are included in this release.

### Localization

* Add Persian localization by @aliafshany in #755
  * Fix right-to-left layout of the donation text by @aliafshany in #756

## New Contributors

* @aliafshany made their first contribution in #755
* @signothecat made their first contribution in #768

### Support Development

We are accepting donations to support ongoing development.

* [Open Collective](https://opencollective.com/clipy)
* [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/Econa77)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Clipy/Clipy/compare/1.4.0...1.4.1
